adoption: src/teleon/retrieval (embedding_port/hybrid/pgvector_index/primitive_match) should import resolve_active_backends() from this module and tag every stored vector + every query with the active embedder_id+dim; a mismatch is a bug surfaced, not a silent 0.0.
rule: A query vector may only be cosine-compared against index vectors produced by the SAME embedder (same model + same dim). Matching across dims is forbidden. Cosine MUST raise / skip-with-reason on dim mismatch, never silently return 0.0 (a silent zero lets a dense plane lie green).
